text:
The dish looks like a salsa or pico de gallo made of diced tomato, red onion, cilantro and some yellow pieces, possibly mango or pineapple. It sits on a white plate that is roughly 24 cm across, which I'm using as the ruler.

The food covers a patch about 11 by 12 cm and is perhaps 2-3 cm deep. That works out to roughly 150 g of food.

Salsa with a little fruit comes to about 0.35 kcal/g, so 150 g gives roughly 50 kcal. Mango or pineapple pieces and possibly some oil would raise that a bit, so I'm estimating about 60 kcal.

{"kcal": 60, "mass_g": 160}
